description: This file defines the KinesisCheckpointer class, a helper for managing checkpointing in a Spark Streaming Kinesis integration. It handles checkpointing logic, thread management, and resource cleanup.

classes.name: KinesisCheckpointer
classes.description: A class for managing Kinesis checkpointing, including periodic checkpointing, thread management, and cleanup.

methods.name: setCheckpointer
methods.description: Updates the checkpointer instance for a specific shardId.

methods.name: removeCheckpointer
methods.description: Stops tracking a shardId and optionally performs a final checkpoint.

methods.name: checkpoint
methods.description: Performs checkpointing for a specific shardId.

methods.name: checkpointAll
methods.description: Checkpoint sequence numbers for all active shards.

methods.name: startCheckpointerThread
methods.description: Starts the recurring timer thread for periodic checkpointing.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the checkpointer, stopping the thread and clearing resources.
